failure.action: Latch failure, retain open watchdog FD, cease keepalives and await hardware expiry; never run normal shutdown, whose driver shutdown callback stops WDT
failure.service_restart: No systemd Restart=always or automatic guardian replacement; failure cannot obtain a fresh startup deadline
failure.signals: SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP latch expiry and retain ownership. SIGKILL unexpectedly releases fd; current core gives one final ping then leaves active timer, subject to physical proof and no competing opener.
failure.budget: Nominal reset no later than startup deadline plus accepted hardware timeout, with a bounded preexec phase. BCM interrupt/time-left quirks and physical reset must be separately measured.
failure.metadata: RO metadata partitions prevent ordinary rc auto-commit, not raw whole-disk writes or privileged BLKROSET. Trial slot must differ from verified committed known-good slot and one-shot next-boot choice must be read back.
failure.guardian_lifetime: Real PID1 SquashFS-to-ext4 handoff fixtures show immutable static child survives exec into systemd init.scope and ownership query rejects forged root server. Device hardware lifetime/reset remains unproven.
failure.prearm_limit: Kernel4.19 watchdog core may keep feeding a bootloader-active watchdog before a userspace owner opens it; no open_timeout is present. Arbitrary pre-ARM userspace/D-state hangs are not covered by a claimed40-second hardware reset. Bounded preflight and parent fallback/emergency paths only cover processes that can progress or be reaped.
